title: SuperPipeline check.overridden
description: A workspace owner or admin passed a check by hand (charter 2026-11-09, a gate may be decided by checks §5). by is a principal id. Mirrors SuperPipeline's CheckOverriddenBody (apps/api/src/board/views.ts). Readers ignore properties they do not know.

boardId.description: Null only on a board not yet initialised; a carrier needs it to route the event.

arrivalId.description: The card's arrival at the stage this check belongs to: one per arrival, so a carrier says each once.

comment.description: Why, as the person wrote it; the board refuses a blank one.
